name: Shosanbetsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shosanbetsu village emblem in orange: a stylised mountain of stacked chevrons.
history: Municipal flag of Shosanbetsu, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 16 April 1968.

features.role: Shosanbetsu village emblem — a stylised mountain of stacked chevrons
